name: Best-AI.org

sources.title: Homepage — live directory of 4,200+ reviewed AI tools, 17 categories, run by BitAutor (Hannover, Germany)
Submit Tool page — 'Free Submission', 3-step flow (Submit Details / We Review / Go Live), 'Free Forever', 1-2 week review time

requirements: AI tool — directory is limited to AI products across 17 categories
Submission itself is free ('Free Submission', 'Free Forever')
Editorial review takes 1-2 weeks; team 'verifies and enriches' the listing
preparation: Feature list and pricing model details (form asks for 'info, features, and pricing')
Category fit within the 17 listed categories
workflow: Fill in the tool's info, features, and pricing in the submission form
Submit; the editorial team reviews over ~1-2 weeks
Once approved, the tool is listed and becomes discoverable in search, categories, and Top-100 voting
watchFor: The submit page's form fields are JS-rendered and did not appear in a static fetch — an interactive browser session may be needed
Default sort is stated as 'no pay-to-rank'; paid 'Place your AI tool here' advertising slots exist but are separate from organic listing
Site claims community voting influences ranking — listing position is not guaranteed
countsAsLive: The tool has a public detail page under best-ai-tools.org/tools/ and appears in its category listing/search
unknowns: Exact form fields and whether an account is required (form is client-rendered)
Whether listings can be updated or claimed after publication
